items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of orthopedic insoles
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 14 Apr 2025. Under §37 Abs. 2 SGB X a posted administrative letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 18 Apr 2025 (this day does not shift even though it falls on Karfreitag, a public holiday, per the special social-law rule). Counting of the one-month period starts the next day (§187 Abs. 1 BGB / §26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, i.e. Sun 18 May 2025. Since that day is a Sunday, the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 19 May 2025 (§26 Abs. 3 SGB X).
